description:
🚨 **BREAKPOINT 2026**

**“Every industry has one. Find it. Study it. Defend it.”**
**What happens when an industry appears to be growing, while underlying changes begin to disrupt the way it operates?**
**Breakpoint 2026 is a two-round case study competition that challenges participants to investigate real-world industry problems, identify underlying causes, develop evidence-based perspectives, and defend their recommendations before a jury.**
**This is not a conventional quiz with a predefined answer, nor is it a hackathon focused solely on building a product. There may be multiple valid perspectives, what matters is the strength of your reasoning, evidence, and ability to defend your decisions.**

🎟️ **CONVERGENCE PASS REQUIRED**
A valid Convergence Pass is mandatory for participation in Breakpoint 2026.
👉 Get your Convergence Pass:
[https://aspireup.ai/organization/convergence-vnrvjiet/event/10011](https://aspireup.ai/organization/convergence-vnrvjiet/event/10011)

**WHAT WILL YOU BE CHALLENGED WITH?**
Consider a problem such as:
India's IT Paradox
India's IT industry continues to grow, yet entry-level opportunities are becoming increasingly competitive.
• Is AI replacing entry-level work?
• Is the industry changing what it expects from fresh graduates?
• Is automation only one part of the story?
• What does this mean for students entering the workforce?
• What should students and the industry do in response?
You will not be given the answer.
Your team will have to research the issue, identify relevant evidence, determine the underlying causes, understand the stakeholders involved, develop an independent perspective, and present a practical recommendation.
And that is only Round 1.

**ROUND 1 — RESEARCH & PITCH**
Teams will randomly receive an industry problem and will be given a limited research and preparation window.
You will need to:
🔍 Understand the problem
📊 Identify relevant data and evidence
🧠 Analyse the underlying causes
👥 Evaluate the stakeholders affected
💡 Develop an independent perspective
🚀 Propose a practical solution or future outlook
Teams will then present their analysis and recommendations before a jury.
Be prepared to answer questions, justify your assumptions, and defend the important claims behind your argument.
The strongest 5–7 teams will advance to Round 2.

**ROUND 2 — THE COMPLEX CASE**
The challenge becomes significantly more demanding.
Qualifying teams will receive a new and more complex case involving multiple dimensions of a real-world industry problem.
With only 45 minutes to research and prepare, teams will need to:
• Quickly understand the situation
• Identify the key issues
• Evaluate competing trade-offs
• Make informed decisions
• Develop a defensible recommendation
The final presentation will be followed by deeper questioning from the jury.
There will be no opportunity for extensive preparation or rehearsed responses. Your ability to think, adapt and defend your reasoning will be tested.
RAPID FIRE — THE FINAL TEST
Think the final presentation is the end?
Not quite.
Finalists will face a rapid-fire tie-breaker. Each team will receive an on-the-spot question and have 30 seconds to respond.
No discussion.
No preparation.
Just your reasoning.

**PRIZE POOL — ₹10,000**
🥇 1st Prize — ₹5,000
🥈 2nd Prize — ₹3,000
🥉 3rd Prize — ₹2,000

**TEAM DETAILS**
Team Size: 3–4 members
Maximum Teams: 40
Build a team with people who can research, analyse, construct arguments, present ideas, and challenge each other's thinking.

**WHO SHOULD PARTICIPATE?**
Breakpoint 2026 is designed for students interested in:
🧠 AI & Technology
📊 Business & Strategy
🔍 Research & Analysis
💡 Problem Solving
🚀 Startups & Innovation
🎤 Presentations & Public Speaking
📈 Industry Trends
⚔️ Case Interviews & Consulting-style Problem Solving
You do not need to be an expert in every industry.
You need to be willing to investigate, think critically, and build a case.

**EVENT DETAILS**
Event: Breakpoint 2026
Date: 18 September 2026
Team Size: 3–4 members
Maximum Teams: 40
Prize Pool: ₹10,000
Convergence Pass: Mandatory

📲 **JOIN THE OFFICIAL WHATSAPP GROUP**
Stay updated with event announcements, important updates, and further instructions for Breakpoint 2026.
[https://chat.whatsapp.com/KtkzYXOyjsqJCeIW5K83eg](https://chat.whatsapp.com/KtkzYXOyjsqJCeIW5K83eg)

🔥 **THE QUESTION ISN'T “DO YOU KNOW THE ANSWER?”**
**CAN YOU DEFEND YOUR ANSWER?**
**Find the breakpoint.**
**Study it.**
**Build your case.**
**Defend it.**
**🚀 See you at Breakpoint 2026.**

description:
Generative AI is rapidly changing how we build applications, work with data, and develop software. But what exactly is Generative AI, how do Foundation Models and LLMs work, and how do these concepts translate into real-world solutions on AWS?
In this session, we’ll start with the **fundamentals of Generative AI** and progressively connect those concepts to practical AWS services through hands-on demonstrations.

### What we'll cover

**1\. Generative AI Fundamentals**

* AI vs. Generative AI
* What makes Generative AI different
* What GenAI can create — text, images, code, audio, and video

**2\. Foundation Models & LLMs**

* What Foundation Models are
* How they differ from traditional task-specific models
* Understanding Large Language Models (LLMs)
* How a single model can perform multiple tasks
* Real-world Generative AI applications

**3\. Working with Generative AI**

* Prompt Engineering
* Few-Shot Prompting
* Understanding and handling hallucinations
* Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
* AI Agents and tool/API integration

### Live Demos

**Amazon Bedrock**
Explore Foundation Models, generate content, and see how **RAG and Knowledge Bases** connect models with external and enterprise data.
**PartyRock**
Build a Generative AI application without writing code, understand what happens behind the application, and see how user inputs can generate personalised results.
**Amazon Q Developer**
See how Generative AI can become part of the software development workflow — from generating and explaining code to debugging, fixing, and refactoring it.

### Bringing It All Together

We’ll close by looking at where Generative AI fits within the AWS ecosystem, including:

* **Amazon Bedrock** — building applications with Foundation Models
* **PartyRock** — experimenting and building GenAI applications without coding
* **Amazon Q Developer** — AI-assisted software development
* **Knowledge Bases** — connecting GenAI applications to enterprise knowledge using RAG
* **Agents for Amazon Bedrock** — connecting AI models to tools, APIs, and business workflows

Whether you're **new to Generative AI or already experimenting with LLMs**, this session is designed to give you a clear understanding of the concepts while showing how they can be applied using AWS.
Come learn the fundamentals, see the technology in action, and understand how to move **from Generative AI concepts to practical AWS solutions.**

title: Generative AI: From Fundamentals to AWS

**Event Details:**

* **Date:** 19 September
* **Time:** 10:00 AM IST
* **Speaker:** Naveen Nagar \| [LinkedIn Profile](https://www.linkedin.com/in/naveen-nagar-01108730/)

**About the Event:** In today's data-driven world, organizations increasingly need to make sense of high-volume, fast-moving data - sensor telemetry, clickstreams, transactions, and logs - before the opportunity to act on it passes. Join us for this technical meetup as we explore Fabric Eventhouse, Microsoft Fabric's purpose-built engine for real-time analytics. This session will move beyond traditional batch pipelines to demonstrate a modern, low-latency data architecture where streaming data is captured, indexed, and made queryable within seconds. We will walk through a complete real-time data flow - from a live streaming source, into Eventhouse, and out to every consuming engine in Fabric via OneLake - without data duplication or performance trade-offs.
**What we will cover:**

* **Architecture:** An end-to-end walkthrough of a real-time pipeline built on Fabric Eventstream, Eventhouse, and OneLake.
* **Eventstream & Ingestion:** How Eventstream captures, transforms, and routes streaming events from sources such as Azure Event Hub, IoT Hub, and CDC connectors into Eventhouse.
* **Eventhouse & KQL Database:** How KQL databases automatically index and time-partition data on arrival, and how update policies and materialized views enrich and aggregate data as it lands.
* **OneLake Availability:** How a single copy of streaming data becomes instantly available to Power BI, Warehouses, Notebooks, and Lakehouses through OneLake, eliminating the need for separate ETL copies.
* **Live Demo:** A practical, live walkthrough showing data flow from a streaming source, through Eventstream, into Eventhouse, out to OneLake, and into a live Power BI report in near real-time.

**This session is designed for:**

* Data Engineers & Architects working with streaming data
* Power BI Developers & Fabric Users
* Analytics teams building real-time or near-real-time dashboards
* Anyone evaluating Microsoft Fabric's Real-Time Intelligence capabilities
title: Handling Real Time data in Fabric Eventhouse

#### Description

Mode: Online
Date & Time: 26 Sept 10 AM IST
Managing time and attendance across a global workforce requires organizations to balance regulatory compliance, corporate policies, and operational efficiency. Traditional approaches often rely on manual reviews and fragmented processes, making it difficult to consistently identify compliance risks and potentially fraudulent activities in a timely manner.

This session presents a real-world success story of a Machine Learning-powered Working Hours Alert System (WHAS) for modernizing workforce compliance monitoring and fraud detection. The solution analyzes time and attendance data to identify compliance risks, detect anomalous working-hour patterns that may indicate fraud, and recommend schedule adjustments aligned with labor laws and organizational policies.

The session focuses on the data and machine learning aspects of building an intelligent compliance monitoring solution. Attendees will learn how workforce data can be analyzed to identify meaningful patterns, design effective alerts, support anomaly detection, and enable proactive intervention. The discussion will also cover implementation considerations, transparency, human oversight, and lessons learned from deploying an AI-driven compliance solution in a global enterprise environment.

By connecting machine learning with enterprise workforce data, the presentation demonstrates how organizations can reduce manual effort, improve consistency in compliance monitoring, strengthen governance, and support more informed operational decisions. Attendees will gain practical perspectives they can apply when designing scalable data and analytics solutions for workforce compliance and operational integrity.
title: Workforce Compliance and Time Fraud Detection reporting using PowerBI

**About the Event: Beyond the Hype - The Rise of Agentic AI in Manufacturing**
We hear a lot about AI these days, but on the factory floor, technology only creates real value when it definitively reduces costs and saves time. Enter **Agentic AI** \- the next evolution of artificial intelligence that goes beyond merely analyzing data to taking autonomous\, intelligent action\.
But what does this actually look like in a modern, high-stakes plant environment?
Join us as we cut through the buzzwords and explore how Agentic AI is practically rewiring manufacturing operations. We will uncover how these autonomous systems are revolutionizing plant management across three critical frontiers:

* **The Data Detective (Log Analysis at Scale):** What if your systems could instantly process millions of complex machine logs, cut through the noise, and tell you exactly what to fix *before* a costly failure occurs?
* **The Master Planner (Dynamic Order Scheduling):** Static planning is no longer enough. Discover how AI assistants can process real-time variables to instantly reroute, reschedule, and optimize orders - minimizing downtime and squeezing every drop of efficiency out of your operations.
* **The Always-On Sentinel (Continuous Surveillance):** Imagine an intelligent system that never sleeps, continuously monitoring your entire facility to proactively identify anomalies, flag potential bottlenecks, and spot abnormal elements the moment they appear.

Are you ready to see how Agentic AI is moving from science fiction to factory floor reality? Join us to learn how autonomous intelligence can transform your operational efficiency and keep you ahead of the curve.

**WHAT IS THIS VIRTUAL WORKSHOP IS ABOUT?**
UiPath Maestro Flow lets you orchestrate multiple automations, AI agents, and human decision points as one connected process — with full visibility into where a case is at any moment. Instead of just automating a task, you're orchestrating an entire business outcome. This session is your chance to build that kind of process yourself, step by step.

**WHAT WE'LL DO DURING THE SESSION**

* Working in UiPath Maestro Flow, you'll design and configure a live process that:
* Triggers automatically when an invoice email arrives
* Extracts and transforms the invoice data
* Queries Purchase Order records to validate the invoice against the matching PO
* Branches based on whether the vendor name matches — routing to the right next step automatically
* Hands off to an AI agent to investigate discrepancies, or to a second AI agent to research an unfamiliar vendor name
* Inserts a human review checkpoint for cases that need a judgment call
* Auto-drafts a response and sends it back to the vendor/requester — closing the loop without manual effort

You'll configure each stage yourself in UiPath Maestro Flow, connect the agents and human task into the flow, and test it against real sample scenarios (matching vendor, mismatched vendor, valid alias, invalid vendor).

**WHAT YOU'LL WALK AWAY WITH**
By the end of the session, you'll have built a working, end-to-end agentic process in UiPath Maestro Flow that autonomously verifies invoices against purchase orders, brings in AI agents for judgment-heavy steps, escalates to a human only when needed, and auto-responds — all orchestrated and trackable.
You'll also leave with a reusable pattern you can apply to any similar exception-handling process in your own environment.

Join us to explore the newest capabilities🚀
title: Build an Agentic Invoice Verification Process with UiPath Maestro Flow

A portal is just a front door. The real complexity of an Internal Developer Platform (IDP) sits in the backend layer beneath it. As autonomous AI agents begin using your platform, traditional setups built only for human developers face immediate security gaps and operational bottlenecks. Join Sameera Jayasoma and Lakmal Warusawithana, maintainers of the CNCF OSS project OpenChoreo, as they show how to build an agent-ready platform without a multi-year custom build.

In this session, you will learn:
- **Platform vs. portal:** Why a portal alone is not enough, and how owning the backend execution layer speeds up software delivery.
- **Designing for AI agents:** How to give AI agents their own identities, limited access, and safety rules when interacting with your APIs, shifting your engineering team from working _inside_ the loop to _orchestrating_ it.
- **Practical open source adoption:** How to use a modular architecture like OpenChoreo to connect the Kubernetes, CI/CD, and monitoring tools you already run, turning your existing tools into secure, agent-ready golden paths

Speaker: Sameera Jayasoma
VP and Distinguished Engineer @ WSO2, OpenChoreo Maintainer

Speaker: Lakmal Warusawithana
title: How to build an agent-ready IDP with open source tools

Build a Diffusion Model from Scratch on 6 GB VRAM \| Image → Video → Audio → Text → Omni

How does a model learn to create an image, generate a video, produce text, or work across multiple modalities—starting from nothing but noise?

In this hands-on workshop, we will build an intuitive understanding of **diffusion models from first principles**, starting with the mathematics and fundamental idea of adding noise and learning to reverse that process.

We will then trace the **evolution of diffusion architectures**, from the early diffusion models to modern approaches used across **image, video, text, audio/multimodal, and Omni-generation systems**.

We’ll explore concepts such as:

* Forward diffusion and the reverse denoising process
* Noise schedules, timesteps, and denoising objectives
* DDPM and DDIM
* U-Net–based diffusion architectures
* Latent Diffusion Models
* Diffusion Transformers (DiT)
* Flow Matching and modern diffusion/flow-based architectures
* How diffusion evolved from image generation into video and multimodal generation
* How modern Omni models combine multiple modalities within generative architectures

The workshop will conclude with a **live implementation of a diffusion model from scratch**—building the forward-noising process, neural network, training loop, and reverse-generation process ourselves.

The entire hands-on implementation will be designed to run on a **consumer GPU with just 6 GB of VRAM**, making it possible to understand diffusion without requiring expensive hardware.

**From noise → mathematics → architecture → a working generative model.**
title: Diffusion Models from First Principles: From Images to Video & Text

After two years of hype, many enterprises feel they’ve overspent on AI infrastructure without realizing the promised value.
In this session, Dan Ciruli, Kelsey Hightower, and Luca Galante cut through the buzzwords to show what enterprise AI infrastructure actually looks like in production.

In most cases, it is often less about training models from scratch and more about how platform engineering teams can fold AI inference and fine-tuning directly into their existing infrastructure.

**Join the discussion to learn:**
1. Why you don’t need infrastructure for training models from scratch, and how to start treating inference and fine-tuning just like serving standard web APIs.
2. Strategies for folding AI workloads and autonomous agents into your existing heterogeneous environments (VMs + containers + legacy databases) without rebuilding everything.
3. How to build an Agentic Development Platform (ADP) based on actionable reference architectures to deploy real-world AI applications.

Speaker: Kelsey Hightower
Retired Distinguished Engineer, Google Cloud. Author, Investor, and Technical Advisor

Speaker: Dan Ciruli

description:
**Want to upgrade your Python skills for the Quantum Era?**

You don't need a PhD in theoretical physics to program a quantum computer—you just need the right open-source tools. With Qiskit, software engineers and data scientists are already building and simulating quantum algorithms using Python.

The Mumbai Quantum Computing Group invites you to our live online session: "***Introduction to Qiskit Programming***"
In 60 high-impact minutes, we’re bridging the gap between classical coding and quantum execution, showing you how to construct, simulate, and run quantum programs.

**📅 Save the Date:**
🗓️ Date: Saturday, 26 September 2026
⏰ Time: 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM IST
📍 Mode: Online (via Google Meet)

Meeting link will be shared with the registered participants on the day of the event.

**What you'll learn:**
✅ The Qiskit SDK architecture and setup
✅ Building quantum registers, qubits, and circuit workflows in Python
✅ Simulating circuits locally vs. executing on IBM Quantum hardware
✅ Interactive Live Q&A

Whether you're a developer, researcher, student, or deep-tech enthusiast looking to expand your skill set, this session will give you a clear, actionable foundation.

🎟️ Slots are limited to keep the Q&A interactive— *RVSP* now to grab your spot!

#QuantumComputing #QuantumGates #Qiskit #DeepTech #QuantumCircuits #SoftwareEngineering #TechEvents #MumbaiTech #Webinar

description:
**Note - To sign up for this event, you must register and be approved here: https://luma.com/q1yzh1r3**

Your AI app is only as smart as the data it can reach. Bolt a model onto a pile of disconnected tables and you get confident answers with nothing underneath them - an agent that can't tell you how it knows what it knows, and an API that hands back rows instead of insight.

​Every team building with agents right now is solving the same problem: where does the data, its relationships and its meaning actually live, so an agent can recall what matters and an API can return answers rather than raw records?

​We're teaming up with the Hyderabad GraphQL community for an evening on exactly that - knowledge graphs as the memory and context layer for AI with SurrealDB, and GraphQL APIs that use intelligent resolvers to deliver insight, not just data. Real talks, live demos, and time with engineers building on agents, graphs and modern APIs across the city.
​
Refreshments and plenty of time for networking.

**Note - To sign up for this event, you must register and be approved here: https://luma.com/q1yzh1r3**
title: Context Layers for AI: Knowledge Graphs & Intelligent APIs
